title: Virtual when it can be, platform when it must be

cases.says: A daemon spec at NORM_PRIORITY gets an unstarted virtual thread with the spec's name.
Starting the returned thread runs the task.
A non-daemon spec gets a non-daemon platform thread, since a virtual thread is always daemon.
A spec with a priority other than NORM_PRIORITY, higher or lower, gets a platform thread with that priority, since a virtual thread ignores priorities.
A spec that is neither a daemon nor at NORM_PRIORITY gets a platform thread with both settings: not a daemon, and its priority.
